changelog:
- Adds a dedicated `oo-esa` skill for working with esa.io through an OOMOL-connected account.
- Supports the full post lifecycle, including creating, reading, updating, appending, prepending, duplicating, shipping, archiving, and rolling back posts.
- Covers collaboration workflows with comments, backlinks, post summaries, and markdown syntax help.
- Includes discovery and navigation tools for teams, categories, tags, members, stats, search, and recent posts.
- Uses the `oo` CLI connector schema/run flow so each action follows the live API contract before execution.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@3e4b3ff`
summary: esa (esa.io). Use this skill for ANY esa request — reading, creating, updating, and deleting data. Whenever a task involves esa, use this skill instead of calling the API directly.
